title: In-situ Raman spectroscopy of amorphous calcium phosphate to crystalline hydroxyapatite transformation
author: Stammeier, Purgstaller, et al.

steps.title: Digest samples for ICP‑OES
steps.instruction: Digest solid samples in 0.45 mol L⁻¹ analytical‑grade HNO₃ (p.a.) before measuring elemental concentrations with a PerkinElmer Optima 8300 ICP‑OES (analytical uncertainty ±2%).

steps.title: Record XRD patterns
steps.instruction: Perform qualitative X‑ray diffraction on randomly oriented precipitate preparations using a PANalytical X'Pert PRO diffractometer equipped with a Co‑tube (40 kV, 40 mA), spinner stage, 0.5° divergence and anti‑scattering slits, and a Scientific X'Celerator detector; scan 4–85° 2θ with a step size of 0.008° 2θ.
